title: Tutorial on Autoencoders
description: A code-first introduction to compact representations, denoising, convolutional models, and variational autoencoders.
body: Autoencoders are neural networks trained to reconstruct their input. Their key feature is an internal bottleneck that compresses the input into a lower-dimensional code before reconstructing it.
The accompanying repository contains four self-contained notebooks covering dimensionality reduction, denoising autoencoders, convolutional autoencoders, and variational autoencoders.
